posts.zh:
dsh-popout-sidebar 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-81e243523d379526887a.html
posts.en:
dsh-popout-sidebar is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-81e243523d379526887a.html
